subject: Follow-up: PR & supplier setup (Coupa/Ariba) — next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jared Klein <jared.klein@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 10 Aug 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Follow-up: PR & supplier setup (Coupa/Ariba) — next steps

Hi Jared —

Thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps to keep procurement moving: 

Summary:
- Acme Health is interested in Redwood Dedicated for a pilot (estimated first-year commit ~$120k).
- Procurement needs to confirm preferred commercial path: PO via Coupa vs. P-Card for smaller purchases, and whether marketplace onboarding (AWS Marketplace) is desired.

Action items we need from your side to create the PR / supplier setup in Coupa/Ariba:
1) Confirm whether Acme will issue a PO (Coupa) or prefer P-Card for initial payment (thresholds noted below).
2) If PO: confirm the internal cost center and PR owner to route the Purchase Requisition.
3) If supplier not already in Coupa: procurement will need Redwood's legal name, tax ID (EIN), W-9, address, and a primary contact for onboarding.

Notes on thresholds (per what we discussed):
- P-Card typically used for purchases under $2,000.
- PR/PO required for purchases >$5,000 (finance/prior approval may be needed).

I've attached a short PR template and the onboarding checklist to make it easy for your team to link Redwood as a supplier in Coupa/Ariba. Please let me know if you want us to route any of this directly to your supplier-ops contact — happy to coordinate.

Next steps (proposed):
- Jared: confirm PO vs card and provide the PR owner + cost center (by EOD Wed).
- Marissa/Aditya: provide W-9 & vendor info and confirm Marketplace interest.
- Once we have vendor details, we’ll submit the Coupa supplier request (or provide files for your supplier-ops).

Attachments: redwood-pr-template.pdf (PR details & suggested line items)

Thanks —

Marissa Cole
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0142

From: Jared Klein <jared.klein@acmehealth.com>

Date: Tue, 11 Aug 2026 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up: PR & supplier setup (Coupa/Ariba) — next steps

Marissa —

Thanks for the clear recap. A few updates from procurement: 

- Acme does use Coupa as our primary supplier system. If Redwood is not in our vendor list, procurement will need a completed supplier onboarding form and a W-9. I attached our Coupa onboarding PDF for reference.
- For commercial path: we can issue a PO for the pilot (preferred for visibility) — amounts above $5k require PR routing and approvals. P-Card is an option for any initial setup fees under $2k, but given the pilot size PO is probably appropriate.
- Please provide Redwood’s legal entity name, EIN, mailing address, remit address, and a copy of your W-9. Once we have that, procurement will create the supplier record and share the supplier ID.

Procurement note: internal ticket #PROC-8421 created on our side for vendor onboarding. If you have a preferred vendor code or marketplace interest (AWS Marketplace), include that in the submission so we can mark the record appropriately.
